fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of water into the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage. It then runs on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy hit [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Kedge Haul
fusions.desc: Sinks an anchor into a target up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it along the cable: it deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 7 tiles, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bucket Brigade
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Lifeline
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
